opportunity to read the formal Chapter Reports which are submitted at our National Conventions.

reports so that they may have a full year's review of their own Chapters and such other Chapters

ship, makes it possible for all of these reports to receive wide circulation in the Fraternity.

Summer Issue to reports of National Convention activities, since such reports have heretofore
